decision.reason: [ev-793f1f2f3e70] is the only prose source, and it bundles three separate changes into one bullet: (1) Cilium now uses the port in the etcd configuration instead of the service's port when the address is a Kubernetes service DNS name, (2) service-DNS-to-ClusterIP translation is now turned on automatically for etcd, and (3) the `etcd.operator` `kvstore-opt` option is now a no-op and has been removed. These need different subjects, change types and exposure conditions, so they can't be written as one typed assertion. The excerpt also doesn't say where `etcd.operator` is configured. The values validator, using [ev-28e0ccb5774a] and [ev-39a22d88e2f5], found that `etcd.operator.kvstore-opt` is not a Helm values key in either release, so P1's helm-value subject is wrong. To proceed, the bundle should be split into one item per change, with evidence for each, such as the kvstore-opt or agent-flag definitions and the PR, showing the configuration surface and the old and new behaviour.
